newsitem.title: USA: Astra and NanoSystems to collaborate.
newsitem.headline: Astra and NanoSystems to collaborate.

text.p: NanoSystems LLC said Wednesday it would collaborate with Astra AB unit Astra Draco AB to develop new Astra products for the treatment of respiratory disorders.
NanoSystems will apply its patented NanoCrystal(TM) drug formulation technology to develop nanoparticle formulations.
NanoSystems said it would receive an up-front technology licensing fee, milestone and research payments, and manufacturing fees based upon the sale of any products using its NanoCrystal technology.
